newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Libyan prime minister to visit Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Libyan prime minister to visit Morocco.

text.p: Libyan Prime Minister Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud is to pay a working visit to Morocco, starting late on Friday.
A foreign ministry statement said the visit, at the invitation of Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, was aimed at strengthening relations and consolidating bilateral cooperation in all areas.
An official source said Gu'ud, secretary of Libya's General Popular Committee (Cabinet), would be met by Filali and would hold talks with him on Saturday.

Libya last November sent its Secretary of Unity Affairs Jomaa el-Fezzani to Morocco, Tunisia and Algeria, after the announcement by France, Italy, Spain and Portugal that they were setting up a rapid intervention force to ensure peace and stability in the area.
The force was strongly criticised by Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi.
